**Finding submitted: deviation (LICENSE, high severity).**

- **Clause:** § 1.4 (p0008–p0009) is the only inbound grant to us — HDI's grant of "access to, and the right to use" its hosting system and Content administration tools. The § 6.1 trademark licence (p0038) runs from us to HDI, so it is out of scope for this rule.
- **Why it fails the fallback:** the grant runs to "the Company" only, with no coverage of affiliates or contractors acting on our behalf and no notice-based mechanism to add them; it is also silent on revocability, leaving HDI room to argue it can withdraw access at will. § 10.3 (Assignment) already binds successors and assigns, so successor transfer is largely handled — noted, not separately flagged.
- **Redline (validated ok:true):** new § 1.4.1 extending the access/use rights to our affiliates and contractors, confirming non-revocability except for uncured material breach or on termination, and confirming successor transferability, with affiliate-on-written-notice offered as a fallback.
